event_name: Document 42 Date 30 September 2018 Time 15:10 2018 RUSSIAN GRAND PRIX 27 - 30 September 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Reported moving more than once to defend the position.
offence: Involved in an alleged incident as defined by Art 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and an alleged breach of Appendix L Chapter IV of the International Sporting Code Article 2b).
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that the move by the driver of car 5 did not constitute two significant changes in direction.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 42 2018 Russian Grand Prix Decision Car 5 Incident With Car 44 In Turn 2
